verses.text: Have you sg seen the one who denies the Recompense[1]?
It is the one who mistreats the orphan
and does not urge (others to serve) food to the destitute sg.
So woe to the ones who pray—
those who are heedless of their prayers,
those who make show (of their deeds)

footnotes.1: The Arabic word used is deen which means ‘a way of life’, ‘religion’ or ‘recompense’.
footnotes.2: The Arabic word used is; it denotes ma’oun small acts of help like lending house utensils, the withholding of which is a sign of stinginess.
